chunks.ar: في يوم من الأيام، ذهب ناسك إلى السوق واشترى ماعزًا سمينًا.
chunks.en_old: One day, an ascetic went to the market and bought a fat goat.
chunks.en_new: One day, an ascetic went to the market and bought a fat goat.

chunks.ar: دفع ثمنه، وربط حبلًا حول رقبته،
chunks.en_old: He paid for it, tied a rope around its neck,
chunks.en_new: He paid for it, tied a rope around its neck,

chunks.ar: ثم بدأ يمشي به إلى بيته.
chunks.en_old: and started walking home with it.
chunks.en_new: and started walking home with it.

chunks.ar: كان سعيدًا بما اشتراه، ولم يشك في شيء.
chunks.en_old: He was pleased with his purchase and suspected nothing.
chunks.en_new: He was pleased with his purchase and suspected nothing.

chunks.ar: رأى ثلاثة لصوص الماعز، وأرادوا أخذه دون أن يدفعوا مالًا.
chunks.en_old: Three thieves saw the goat and wanted to take it without paying.
chunks.en_new: Three thieves saw the goat and wanted to take it without paying.

chunks.ar: اجتمعوا خلف شجرة، واتفقوا على حيلة غريبة.
chunks.en_old: They met behind a tree and agreed on a strange trick.
chunks.en_new: They met behind a tree and agreed on a strange trick.

chunks.ar: قال أحدهم: «لن نسرق الماعز بالقوة.
chunks.en_old: One said, “We will not steal the goat by force.
chunks.en_new: One said, “We will not steal the goat by force.

chunks.ar: سنجعل الرجل يتركه بنفسه.»
chunks.en_old: We will make the man abandon it himself.”
chunks.en_new: We will make the man abandon it himself.”

chunks.ar: وقف اللص الأول عند الطريق،
chunks.en_old: The first thief stood by the road.
chunks.en_new: The first thief stood by the road.

chunks.ar: وحين مر الناسك سأله بدهشة: «لماذا تقود كلبًا إلى بيتك؟»
chunks.en_old: When the ascetic passed, he asked in surprise, “Why are you leading a dog home?”
chunks.en_new: When the ascetic passed, he asked in surprise, “Why are you leading a dog home?”

chunks.ar: ضحك الناسك وقال: «هذا ماعز، وليس كلبًا!
chunks.en_old: The ascetic laughed. “This is a goat, not a dog!
chunks.en_new: The ascetic laughed. “This is a goat, not a dog!

chunks.ar: ألا ترى جيدًا؟» ثم واصل طريقه.
chunks.en_old: Can you not see properly?” Then he continued on his way.
chunks.en_new: Can you not see properly?” Then he continued on his way.

chunks.ar: بعد قليل، ظهر اللص الثاني، ونظر إلى الماعز مستغربًا.
chunks.en_old: A little later, the second thief appeared and stared at the goat in astonishment.
chunks.en_new: A little later, the second thief appeared and stared at the goat in astonishment.

chunks.ar: قال: «رجل مثلك يقود كلبًا في الشارع؟ هذا أمر عجيب!»
chunks.en_old: “A man like you leading a dog through the street? How strange!” he said.
chunks.en_new: “A man like you leading a dog through the street? How strange!” he said.

chunks.ar: توقف الناسك وقال لنفسه: «لماذا يسميه الجميع كلبًا؟»
chunks.en_old: The ascetic stopped and wondered, “Why does everyone call it a dog?”
chunks.en_new: The ascetic stopped and wondered, “Why does everyone call it a dog?”

chunks.ar: ثم جاء اللص الثالث، وقال بصوت واثق:
chunks.en_old: Then the third thief came and said confidently,
chunks.en_new: Then the third thief came and said confidently,

chunks.ar: «يا رجل، هذا كلب بلا شك. من باعه لك؟»
chunks.en_old: “My good man, that is certainly a dog. Who sold it to you?”
chunks.en_new: “My good man, that is certainly a dog. Who sold it to you?”

chunks.ar: نظر الناسك إلى الحيوان مرة أخرى،
chunks.en_old: The ascetic looked at the animal again
chunks.en_new: The ascetic looked at the animal again

chunks.ar: وبدأ يشعر بالقلق والحيرة.
chunks.en_old: and began to feel worried and confused.
chunks.en_new: and began to feel worried and confused.

chunks.ar: فكر الناسك: «أنا رأيت ماعزًا في السوق،
chunks.en_old: The ascetic thought, “I saw a goat at the market,
chunks.en_new: The ascetic thought, “I saw a goat at the market,

chunks.ar: لكن ثلاثة رجال يقولون إنه كلب.
chunks.en_old: but three men say it is a dog.
chunks.en_new: but three men say it is a dog.

chunks.ar: هل خدعني البائع؟ أم أنني لا أرى الحقيقة؟»
chunks.en_old: Did the seller deceive me? Or can I no longer see the truth?”
chunks.en_new: Did the seller deceive me? Or am I not seeing the truth?"

chunks.ar: ولم يعرف أي كلام يصدق.
chunks.en_old: He did not know whom to believe.
chunks.en_new: He did not know whom to believe.

chunks.ar: أخيرًا، أقنع نفسه أن البائع ربما سحر عينيه.
chunks.en_old: At last, he convinced himself that perhaps the seller had cast a spell on his eyes.
chunks.en_new: At last, he convinced himself that perhaps the seller had cast a spell on his eyes.

chunks.ar: فك الحبل عن رقبة الماعز، وتركه عند جانب الطريق،
chunks.en_old: He untied the rope, left the goat beside the road,
chunks.en_new: He untied the rope from the goat's neck and left it beside the road,

chunks.ar: ثم عاد إلى السوق غاضبًا ليبحث عن الرجل الذي باعه له.
chunks.en_old: and returned angrily to the market to look for the seller.
chunks.en_new: and returned angrily to the market to look for the seller.

chunks.ar: خرج اللصوص الثلاثة من أماكنهم، وأمسكوا الماعز ومضوا به.
chunks.en_old: The three thieves emerged from their hiding places, took the goat, and went away.
chunks.en_new: The three thieves emerged from their hiding places, took the goat, and went away.

chunks.ar: كانوا يضحكون لأن خطتهم نجحت دون صراع.
chunks.en_old: They laughed because their plan had worked without a struggle.
chunks.en_new: They laughed because their plan had worked without a struggle.

chunks.ar: أما الناسك فكان يبحث عن البائع،
chunks.en_old: The ascetic, meanwhile, was looking for the seller,
chunks.en_new: The ascetic, meanwhile, was looking for the seller,

chunks.ar: ولا يعلم أن الماعز كان ماعزًا طوال الوقت.
chunks.en_old: unaware that his goat had been a goat all along.
chunks.en_new: unaware that his goat had been a goat all along.
